name: Structured
leads: You feel most at home planning ahead — but you flex through all five as situations change.
decide: You naturally prefer to plan ahead and understand your options before deciding. You feel most at ease with organised systems and time to think.
withOthers: A partner who leans Adaptive may want to decide more quickly than feels comfortable to you. Agreeing when a decision needs a plan and when it's fine to move fast can help you both.

name: Adaptive
leads: You feel most at home adjusting as you go — comfortable changing course when circumstances shift.
decide: You naturally prefer to stay flexible and respond to what's in front of you rather than lock everything in.
withOthers: A partner who leans Structured may want more of a plan than feels natural to you. Agreeing a few fixed points, with room to flex around them, can help you both.

name: Reflective
leads: You feel most at home understanding your options fully before deciding.
decide: You naturally prefer to research and weigh things up, so your decisions feel well-founded.
withOthers: A partner who leans Intuitive may want to move on gut feel. Agreeing which decisions are worth the research can help you both.

name: Collaborative
leads: You feel most at home deciding together and talking things through.
decide: You naturally prefer to involve others and reach decisions by discussion.
withOthers: A partner who leans Intuitive or Structured may sometimes want to decide alone. Agreeing which choices are shared and which are each of yours can help you both.

name: Intuitive
meaning: Simple systems, trusting instinct, keeping money light
leads: You feel most at home keeping money simple and trusting your instincts.
decide: You naturally prefer light-touch systems and quick decisions over detailed analysis.
withOthers: A partner who leans Reflective may want more information before deciding. Agreeing when a quick call is fine and when it's worth a closer look can help you both.
